purpose: Teach: つけ加え/まるまる/たんに/思いのほか/ガタガタ/やっとこ/おのずから/じっさい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューに「季節限定」とつけ加えましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's add 'seasonal limited' to the new menu items.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, thoughtful pace. Warm voice leaning slightly forward. Opening is soft but clear. Trails off with quiet confidence — not pushy, just offering.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本日はまるまる仕込みの日だったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Today was really just prep work from start to finish, wasn't it?
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment of shared work. Slight tiredness underneath. Measured pace, looking at the space around them rather than directly. The comfort of someone who was there with you.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様はたんに静かにお茶を楽しまれてただけよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customers were just enjoying their tea quietly — that was enough.
lines.style: Reassuring but not dismissive. Soft, steady voice. Slight emphasis on 'enough' — gentle reframing, like settling a worry. Unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、思いのほか好評ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new menu is getting a better response than we expected.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. Warm tone, almost surprised. Slow pace, savoring the words. Light lift at the end — pleased but not over-confident.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、古い棚がガタガタしてきたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That old shelf has started to rattle more.
lines.style: Observational, matter-of-fact. Noticing without alarm. Even pace. The tone of someone pointing out what needs attention next, already thinking ahead.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、やっとこ新看板出来たね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new sign is finally done.
lines.style: Relief mixed with quiet pride. Soft opening, then lighter on 'done' — a small victory. Warm exhale. Steady, not rushed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の数は、おのずから増えていくはずよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customers will come naturally, as these things do.
lines.style: Gentle wisdom. Quiet, patient voice. Unhurried pace — not convinced, just certain in a quiet way. Slight trailing-off, like trusting something larger than the moment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、じっさいお店の運営は楽じゃないわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Running a shop really isn't easy, is it?
lines.style: Soft realization at the close. Tired but accepting. Pace slows toward the end. The voice of someone who has felt the weight of it — not complaining, just naming it clearly.
